    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                A link to this owner's own resource, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'
                where <id> is the owner's id. Derived from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the honorific 'title'
                followed by a single space and the last name (e.g. 'DR who').
                When no title was given it is just the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last
                names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                and space-separated (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived from the
                stored 'telephone'; the raw E.164 value remains in 'telephone'.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's member id, assigned on create, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': REGION is the region code derived from
                the owner's postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, or UNKNOWN); FY is the two-digit
                fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registration date (the
                fiscal year starts on 1 July); HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the owner's normalized E.164 telephone
                concatenated with the last name; and CHK is a single Luhn check
                digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D4'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted registration
                date, formatted 'FY<YY>' where the fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is identified by the calendar year in which it ends (so a July-to-
                December date falls in the next calendar year's fiscal year) and YY
                is that year's last two digits. Read from the FY segment of the
                owner's memberId.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners who belong to the same
                household (same last name and postcode). Computed deterministically
                as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last
                name and the postcode, so every owner with the same last name and
                postcode maps to the same value regardless of creation order.
              type: string
              example: '9e107d9d372b'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the time this owner was
                created, that shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Computed on create over the
                owners that existed before this one and returned unchanged
                thereafter.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned on creation. Starts at 0;
                adds 2 when an email address is present; adds 1 when the owner has
                no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0); adds 2 for a household of 3 or
                more; adds 3 for a tenure of more than one elapsed fiscal year
                (the fiscal year starts on 1 July). Derived from the owner's own
                fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived from
                the owner's membership points: level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for
                2-3 points, level 3 for 4-5 points, and level 4 for 6 or more
                points. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region), the <REGION> component of the
                owner's memberId (itself derived from the owner's postcode).
                'UNKNOWN' when no region could be derived.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the owner's
                locality (region) via the fixed region-to-timezone table:
                NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane. 'UNKNOWN' when the region is not in
                the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or
                'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when the membership level is
                3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. Derived
                from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners
                had already been created for the same day. Computed on create and
                returned unchanged thereafter.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, the owner's city
                already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the hard
                capacity limit of 50). Computed on create and returned unchanged
                thereafter.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's
                own fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from the owner's birth date against
                the registration date: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to
                64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birth date was given.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key, formatted
                '<telephone>|<email>|<householdId>' from the owner's normalized
                telephone, lower-cased email (empty when absent) and household id
                (empty when absent). This single key drives duplicate detection: a
                new owner is rejected with 409 Conflict only when its whole identity
                key equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, it was flagged as a
                possible (soft) duplicate of an existing owner: not a hard
                duplicate, but sharing an existing owner's last name and postcode
                with a different telephone. Computed on create and returned
                unchanged thereafter.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible
                duplicate of. Present only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the
                record. Deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When present it is used to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on create for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it takes
            precedence over this flat field. On read it is the composed address:
            the normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when 'addressLine2' is present, falling back to
            the normalized flat address when no structured line is given.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Optional.
            When present (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address' and is
            normalized to canonical form (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased,
            common street-type abbreviations expanded). An owner is valid when it
            supplies either a non-blank 'addressLine1' or the flat 'address', plus a
            city.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (unit,
            suite, etc.). When present it is normalized like 'addressLine1' and
            appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must
            have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The normalized value is stored and
            returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. It is normalized to lower case before it is
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid
            for the owner's city per a fixed table keyed by the city's region
            (Sydney -> NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne -> VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane ->
            QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Rejected with 400 when out of range for the city's region.
            The value is stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. The stored value is returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional.
            When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand', computed as
            the owner's age against the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only flag. When true, the owner may be created even though
            another owner already shares the same household (same last name and
            postcode) - an intentional shared household - and is then created as
            a declared household member. When false or omitted, such a duplicate
            is rejected with 409 Conflict. It only bypasses the duplicate block;
            it does not create the household link (that is derived from the last
            name and postcode). Not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                A link to this owner's own resource, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'
                where <id> is the owner's id. Derived from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the honorific 'title'
                followed by a single space and the last name (e.g. 'DR who').
                When no title was given it is just the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last
                names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                and space-separated (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived from the
                stored 'telephone'; the raw E.164 value remains in 'telephone'.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's member id, assigned on create, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': REGION is the region code derived from
                the owner's postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, or UNKNOWN); FY is the two-digit
                fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registration date (the
                fiscal year starts on 1 July); HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the owner's normalized E.164 telephone
                concatenated with the last name; and CHK is a single Luhn check
                digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D4'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted registration
                date, formatted 'FY<YY>' where the fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is identified by the calendar year in which it ends (so a July-to-
                December date falls in the next calendar year's fiscal year) and YY
                is that year's last two digits. Read from the FY segment of the
                owner's memberId.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners who belong to the same
                household (same last name and postcode). Computed deterministically
                as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last
                name and the postcode, so every owner with the same last name and
                postcode maps to the same value regardless of creation order.
              type: string
              example: '9e107d9d372b'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the time this owner was
                created, that shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Computed on create over the
                owners that existed before this one and returned unchanged
                thereafter.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned on creation. Starts at 0;
                adds 2 when an email address is present; adds 1 when the owner has
                no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0); adds 2 for a household of 3 or
                more; adds 3 for a tenure of more than one elapsed fiscal year
                (the fiscal year starts on 1 July). Derived from the owner's own
                fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived from
                the owner's membership points: level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for
                2-3 points, level 3 for 4-5 points, and level 4 for 6 or more
                points. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region), the <REGION> component of the
                owner's memberId (itself derived from the owner's postcode).
                'UNKNOWN' when no region could be derived.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the owner's
                locality (region) via the fixed region-to-timezone table:
                NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane. 'UNKNOWN' when the region is not in
                the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or
                'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when the membership level is
                3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. Derived
                from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners
                had already been created for the same day. Computed on create and
                returned unchanged thereafter.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, the owner's city
                already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the hard
                capacity limit of 50). Computed on create and returned unchanged
                thereafter.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's
                own fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from the owner's birth date against
                the registration date: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to
                64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birth date was given.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key, formatted
                '<telephone>|<email>|<householdId>' from the owner's normalized
                telephone, lower-cased email (empty when absent) and household id
                (empty when absent). This single key drives duplicate detection: a
                new owner is rejected with 409 Conflict only when its whole identity
                key equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, it was flagged as a
                possible (soft) duplicate of an existing owner: not a hard
                duplicate, but sharing an existing owner's last name and postcode
                with a different telephone. Computed on create and returned
                unchanged thereafter.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible
                duplicate of. Present only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the
                record. Deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

I implemented the `riskFlag` field on the owner resource per the spec: it returns `true` when **any** of three conditions hold, otherwise `false`.

**Changes:**

The hard blocklist itself is rejected outright at create time so those never get stored;
   - the city is over its **soft capacity** — `capacityWarning` is true (the ≥40-owners-in-city warning).

2. **`OwnerMapper.java`** — added `RiskFlagDeriver` to the mapper's imports and a `@Mapping(target = "riskFlag", expression = "java(RiskFlagDeriver.riskFlag(owner))")`. All three inputs come from stored owner fields, so the flag is a pure derivation returned consistently on create and read.

3. **`openapi.yml`** — added the read-only `riskFlag` boolean to the `Owner` schema (which generates the `riskFlag` accessor on `OwnerDto`), with a description of the rule.

The existing `coreRiskFlagFalseNormally` test (a normal structured owner: no email, not a duplicate, empty city) correctly reads `$.riskFlag` as `false`.
